429.description: Per-user token-bucket rate limit exceeded. The ``Retry-After`` header carries the wait in seconds; the body repeats the value as ``retry_after_seconds``.

Retry-After.description: Integer seconds before the next request will be admitted.

500.description: Server-side failure. Body shape is always ``{"error": "internal server error"}``.
